Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded in the final step that Giorgi Shengelaia (born 1937) was older than Victor Schertzinger (born 1888). In reality, a smaller birth year indicates an older person. Since 1888 is earlier than 1937, Victor Schertzinger is the older director, making "Road To Singapore" the correct answer. The Planner failed to perform the basic logical comparison of the birth years gathered by the WebSurfer.
